The 2024–25 season is the Bashundhara Kings's 12th competitive professional season since its creation in 2013, and 7th consecutive season in Bangladesh Premier League, country's top-tier football league. In addition to the domestic league, Bashundhara Kings is participating in this season's edition of AFC Challenge League, Federation Cup and Challenge Cup.
